meta.name: anomaly-characterization
meta.description: SOP: Describe and classify anomalous phenomena that existing theory cannot explain

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 描述并分类现有理论无法解释的异常现象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究科学前沿的未解现象
copy.tagline_en: Describe and classify anomalous phenomena beyond current theory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study unexplained phenomena at the frontier of science

howto.what: 当用户描述一个现有理论无法解释的异常现象时，Claude 会按步骤描述现象、量化偏差、排除已知解释，并输出结构化的异常分类报告。
howto.when: 当用户提供具体的异常观察描述（如数据、实验结果）且指明参考基线时触发。

say.text: 我的实验数据比理论预测高30%，可能是什么原因？
say.note: Claude 会量化偏差并排除已知解释。

say.text: 我观察到一种周期性模式，但现有模型说不可能。
say.note: Claude 会分类为意外模式并进一步分析。

howto.what_en: When a user describes an anomalous phenomenon unexplained by existing theory, Claude systematically describes the phenomenon, quantifies deviation, excludes known explanations, and outputs a structured anomaly classification report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a concrete anomalous observation (e.g., data, experimental results) and a reference baseline for comparison.

say_en.text: My experimental data is 30% higher than theoretical prediction. What could be the cause?
say_en.note: Claude will quantify deviation and exclude known explanations.

say_en.text: I observe a periodic pattern that existing models say is impossible.
say_en.note: Claude will classify it as unexpected pattern and analyze further.
